units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.motion: static (background corners constant to 0.05 grey levels over all frames; no pan/shake)
camera.view: top-down (bird's-eye) onto a uniform grey ground plane; both trucks drive horizontally in the image
camera.perspective_note: Rendered with a perspective camera: the cab interiors are seen from different angles as the trucks cross the image, and pixel length changes by ~3% (yellow 314 px at x~1590 -> 304 px at x~800; white 312 -> 302-306). Different heights of the truck move at slightly different pixel rates (low front bumper ~11.26, high cab/roof texture ~11.40 px/frame for yellow). Treat as 2D with one scale; use lengths measured near the image centre (x~960) as the best single value.

objects.name: yellow_truck
objects.description: yellow pickup truck (yellow paint, dark cab glass, yellow bed), upper lane (y ~348-455); front (rounded hood) points left, open bed at right
objects.reference_point: centre of the body box (cx, cy); cx_xcorr = sub-pixel version for differences
objects.motion_summary: stationary frames 0-1 (identical images), then constant leftward motion, pure -x, no vertical motion; per-frame shift -11.40 px (cx_xcorr, rms residual from a line 0.1 px), -11.33 (box centre), -11.26 (front edge), -11.41 (rear edge)

objects.name: white_truck
objects.description: white/silver pickup truck (white hood and roof rails, dark glass, black bed/tonneau), lower lane (y ~489-590); front points left
objects.reference_point: centre of the body box (cx, cy); cx_xcorr = sub-pixel version for differences
objects.motion_summary: stationary frames 0-1, then constant leftward motion, pure -x; per-frame shift -15.96 px (cx_xcorr frames 1-36), -15.88 (frames 36-71), -15.86 (box centre, whole clip), -15.81 front edge, -15.91 rear edge (rear edge exactly -16.00 px/frame in frames 1-36)

objects.name: ground
objects.description: uniform flat grey ground plane (grey ~158), no markings, lanes or other static objects; soft shadows under the trucks

pair_relations.frame0: side by side, fronts aligned (both front_x = 1432, centres dx = 1 px)
pair_relations.later: white truck pulls ahead; centre dx (yellow - white) grows by ~4.5 px/frame: frame 24 = 104, frame 47 = 209, frame 71 = 318 px (box centres)

events.event: both trucks at rest, side by side, fronts aligned
motion starts (first displacement between frame 1 and 2), both trucks
events.note: frame 1 is identical to frame 0; constant velocity from then on (no visible ramp)

events.event: white truck front edge reaches x=960 (image centre)
yellow truck front edge reaches x=960
white truck fully ahead of yellow (white rear_x 677 < yellow front_x 678)
end of clip, both still moving
